prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the wide granite courtyard of Gyeongbokgung Palace with a standard-height palace gate, low stone steps and a waist-high stone balustrade, empty of visitors, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ethiopian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, cool ash-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold ship's anchor, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold bracelets. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal gold wrapping-paper micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, paired with a strapless gold wrapping-paper bandeau with a fine metallic pattern, neatly cut with clean edges and no tears, reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and tied with a small red ribbon bow at the center front, fully opaque and covering only what it must.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Italian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a striking young male model face with sharp straight brows, a strong chin and a visible Adam's apple, a very faint trace of stubble, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, smooth light-olive skin, a confident smirk, natural soft black hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, an iron hammer head, a lead pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked mixed-metal hair ornaments. Extra long nails in matching polished lava rock.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body cooled black lava rock fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid lava rock curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted lava rock sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING rough matte-black volcanic rock surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID glowing orange-red molten fissures running between every section, rough volcanic-textured, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved cooled black lava rock.

RIGHT Cracks: the cooled black lava rock body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right calf, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left calf and one at her left forearm, where the broken edge reveals the raw dull grey-brown rock with a rough pitted surface inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the cooled black lava rock is unbroken and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: standing with both arms relaxed at her sides, palms turned slightly forward, head tilted a little.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme pointed platform stiletto pumps in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved cooled black lava rock right down to the shoes.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
